title: ServiceClient should discover actual HTTP port from runtime state, not static config
description: When mmry service is started with MMRY__EXTERNAL_API__PORT env override (e.g. 48000), the actual listening port differs from config.toml (8081). ServiceClient.get_api_url() reads from config, so clients like agntz fail to connect. The service should write the actual HTTP port to a state file (like it does for gRPC) or clients should read the env var.

title: Add tag filter to search
description: Tags exist in the schema (JSON array) and are stored per memory, but search cannot filter by them. Add optional tags parameter to search that filters memories containing any/all specified tags. Expose via CLI --tag flag. Tags are the cross-tool connector for unified search across hstry/mmry/trx.

title: Episode-based feedback loop — close the loop between search and feedback
description: Make mmry get sharper with use, zero LLM. Every mmry search records an episode (query, returned_ids, ts, agent_ctx). mmry add --using <ids> closes the episode and bumps helpful_count on cited memories. Five derived feedback channels (explicit, implicit positive, implicit negative, co-return lift, drift decay) are pure SQL aggregates over episodes — no separate counter tables until volume forces denormalization. Architectural keystone: storage is a dumb append-only log; intelligence lives in retrieval as pure functions over the episode log.

title: Add episodes table to schema
description: Add episodes(id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, query TEXT, returned_ids JSON, used_ids JSON, result TEXT, agent_ctx_workspace_id TEXT, agent_ctx_platform_session_id TEXT, agent_ctx_harness_session_id TEXT, ts DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) to crates/mmry-core/src/database/schema.rs. Indexes on ts DESC and agent_ctx_workspace_id.

title: Implement episodes module with operations
description: New crates/mmry-core/src/episodes.rs: record_search(query, returned_ids, agent_ctx) -> episode_id, close_episode(episode_id, used_ids), and pure SQL aggregates: helpful_count_from_episodes(memory_id), harmful_count_from_episodes(memory_id) covering explicit (cited via --using) and implicit (subsequent add in session) positive signals plus implicit negative (quick reformulation) and drift decay.

title: Wire episode recording into search path
description: After SearchService::execute_search returns Vec<Memory>, write an episode row with the resolved query, returned memory ids, ts, and AGENT_CTX. Return episode_id alongside results so the CLI can surface it (and so HTTP API can stay byte-stable — episode_id is additive on the response envelope).

title: Add --using flag to mmry add to close episodes
description: mmry add accepts --using <id,id,...> [--episode <ep_id>]. If --episode omitted, default to most-recent open episode for the current AGENT_CTX session within last N minutes. Closes the episode by setting used_ids and bumps implicit helpful_count on the cited memories. CLI-only flag — HTTP API stays unchanged.
